messages:
Jordan (Support): Hey team, acme.ai just opened a ticket — their calls to /v1/rerank are getting 400s. They pasted the payload, looks like an empty candidates array + missing query in some SDK calls. Body from customer:

```json
{
  "candidates": [],
  "context": { "user_id": 123 }
}
```

Response from Redwood: `{"error":"invalid_request"}` (not very helpful). Customer says it started after updating to our JS SDK v0.8.1.

Jordan (Support): Repro steps they gave: 1) call rerank with `candidates: []` 2) sometimes the SDK serializes a single candidate as a string not array (they said `'candidate': 'foo'`), 3) sometimes `query` key is missing entirely.

Jordan (Support): They need a quick workaround and we should decide whether backend should accept empty arrays (and return empty scores) or return a descriptive 400.

Priya (Eng Oncall): Thanks — can you paste the raw request headers and exact curl they used? Also any request-id from our logs? :eyes:

Jordan (Support): Pasted raw curl and request-id: `req_01G8X2YQJ5M1Z9KZ0D3ABCD`

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/rerank \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"candidates": [], "context": {"user_id": 123}}'
```

Marco (Eng Runtime): I pulled the logs for req_01G8X2YQJ5M1Z9KZ0D3ABCD. Backend raised a schema validation error: `ValidationError: /query: missing required property`. We currently validate `query` + `candidates` elements to be array of objects with `id` or `text`. Empty array passes the JSON schema for `candidates` but our business logic expects >0 (we throw downstream). So two problems: (A) noisy generic 400, (B) SDK sending wrong shape in some cases.

Elena (DevEx): @Marco, SDK v0.8.1 release notes mentioned a change in how single-item inputs are normalized — that could explain string->array behavior. We should add a snippet in docs and a runtime check. Quick snippet for customers:

```
// ensure candidates is an array of strings/objects
const payload = {
  query: userQuery, // required
  candidates: Array.isArray(cands) ? cands : [cands]
}
```

Marco (Eng Runtime): Temporary plan: 1) push a small validation layer that returns a descriptive 400, e.g. `{error: "invalid_rerank_request", details:["query is required", "candidates must be non-empty array"]}`. 2) Add defensive handling for single-string candidate and coerce to array for one release cycle. 3) Add unit tests. I can get a PR up in ~2h, can we do a quick patch deploy?

Priya (Eng Oncall): Sounds good. Ops-bot — can we schedule a CI-only hotfix to the runtime? We need to minimize risk but give the customer a fast workaround. :pray:

ops-bot: Deployment pipeline status: canary pipelines green, last deploy 2026-03-14T21:10:12Z. Submit PR to `eng/runtime` with label `hotfix/rerank-400` to trigger expedited rollout.

Amy (Customer Success): I've messaged the customer with two options: (A) immediate client-side fix (one-line guard) and (B) we can deploy the defensive server patch within a few hours. They prefer the server fix but will apply client-side change if we need more time.

Jordan (Support): Adding the suggested client-side snippet to the support ticket now. Also asked for SDK version from customer — they confirmed `@redwood/sdk-js@0.8.1`.

Marco (Eng Runtime): PR opened: `hotfix/rerank-400` -> adding schema error details + coerce single candidate to array + explicit check for empty candidates. Patch includes: 1) new validation middleware, 2) unit test `tests/test_rerank_validation.py` with cases: missing query, candidates empty, candidate as string. Example test payloads included.

Marco (Eng Runtime): Patch diff (excerpt):
```python
# validate.py
if 'query' not in body:
    raise BadRequest(details=['query is required'])
if not isinstance(body.get('candidates'), list) or len(body.get('candidates', [])) == 0:
    raise BadRequest(details=['candidates must be non-empty array'])
# coerce single string -> array (backcompat)
if isinstance(body.get('candidates'), str):
    body['candidates'] = [body['candidates']]
```

Priya (Eng Oncall): LGTM. Marco — coordinate with eng-releases for a quick canary followed by full rollout if canary is green. Add monitoring for 4xx spike post-deploy.

Marco (Eng Runtime): Will do. I'll also add better error codes so support can filter `invalid_rerank_request` easily. ETA deploy: ~3 hours.

Elena (DevEx): I'll update the SDK docs and add a migration note in the changelog indicating the normalization change in 0.8.1 and the recommended payload shape. Also adding a small snippet to the troubleshooting doc: `Rerank 400 -> check query + candidates non-empty + candidates type`.

Amy (Customer Success): Customer replied: "Thanks — we'll wait for the server patch. Appreciate the quick turnaround." :thumbsup:

Jordan (Support): I'll keep the ticket open and update once canary is green. Filing a short internals note for postmortem: root cause likely SDK normalization + lack of descriptive server errors. Follow-ups: add schema tests in CI, update SDK docs, add telemetry metric for `invalid_rerank_request`.

Priya (Eng Oncall): Thanks everyone. If the canary shows any regressions ping `#eng-alerts` immediately.

Jordan (Support): Closing the loop here once deployed.
